# GET /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}/{version}

Gets a specific package version

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-200`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |

|------|----------|-----------|
| Package access mode is determined by owner type (org vs user) and doer relationship | authorization | Owner is org: check team permissions; Owner is user: check if doer is owner or visibility is public/limited |
